messages:
Maya: Quick sync 0; we need to decide SDK retry ownership vs consumer for paging + how a lightweight "page window" should behave across py/ts/go. Short: who retries, what gets exposed, memory bounds.

Dmitri: transport-owned retries for short unary calls is my preference. Expose per-call overrides but default in transport to avoid client footguns. :+1:

Alina: unary yes, but for paged iterators I'd rather the SDK offer hooks and resume tokens than silent auto-retries. Consumers often need control to avoid duplicate side effects.

Juan: Language ergonomics matter:
- Py: generator-based paging (yield pages/items), exceptions on stop/failure.
- TS: async iterators.
- Go: explicit Pager{Next(ctx)} returning (page,err).
We should keep same semantics but idiomatic surfaces.

Maya: Proposed rule-set: transport handles network/backoff for idempotent unary calls. For paged iterators transport provides resume tokens and an opt-in autoretry mode. Default: NO automatic page-level retry outside primitive reconnects.

Dmitri: Define "page window": SDK may prefetch up to N pages (configurable) to bound client memory. Consumer receives an iterator of items. If a prefetch fails inside the window, SDK surfaces a RetryError including resumeToken so consumer decides to resume/retry.

Alina: API sketch (TS):
```ts
for await (const item of client.listRecords({ pageSize:200, prefetch:2 })) {
  // handle item
}
```
If prefetch fails iterator throws RetryError with resumeToken. Consumer can catch and re-invoke starting from token.

Juan: Go sketch:
```go
p := client.ListRecords(ctx, &ListOpts{PageSize:200, Prefetch:2})
for {
  page, err := p.Next()
  if err == iterator.ErrRetry {
    log.Println("resume:", err.ResumeToken())
    // consumer chooses
  }
  if err == io.EOF { break }
}
```

Maya: Default transport retry policy: 3 attempts, exponential backoff + full jitter, only for idempotent-marked calls. We should mark list/get as idempotent in generated SDKs by default, and allow explicit override. Thoughts on idempotency metadata?

Dmitri: Server metadata would be ideal but not reliable. Add a per-method codegen annotation: `idempotent: true/false`. Generated clients mark these methods accordingly.

Alina: Also add a `retryStrategy` option on client config for power users. Keep simple defaults for typical users.

Juan: Streaming vs paged: for server-push streaming we should do transport-level reconnects when supported and only resume if server supplies a resume token. Never auto-retry non-idempotent application ops.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy: feature/soft-page-window on 3 hosts.

Maya: Actions:
- Dmitri: PR to codegen to add idempotent flag on list/get methods.
- Alina: write TS/Py example of prefetch + RetryError shape.
- Juan: doc Go Pager API + error semantics.
- All: agree default prefetch=1 (no prefetch), expose `prefetch` config.

Dmitri: I'll send the codegen PR today.

Alina: Will prototype RetryError: { name:'RetryError', message, resumeToken?, retriedAttempts } and examples for consumer handling.

Juan: I'll add Go error wrapper with ResumeToken() accessor.

Maya: Thanks. We'll follow up with a short RFC delta showing the API snippets. Speak now if you disagree.

Dmitri: No objections.

Alina: SGTM.

Juan: SGTM.

Maya: Closing. Posting RFC delta in #eng-platform after landing PRs. :rocket:
